## Change

Describe the problem and the resulting driving or contributor experience.

## Validation

List checks run and results. For graphics changes, include before/after screenshots and graphics settings. For physics changes, include the relevant telemetry, assumptions and parameter provenance.

## Checklist

- [ ] Lint, tests and production build pass.
- [ ] New behavior preserves clutch, gearbox and reverse safety rules.
- [ ] Documentation and asset licensing match the change.
- [ ] No credentials, generated build files or unrelated changes are included.
